question: Under this policy, will I pay a withdrawal charge?

calls.content:
Yes, you will generally pay a withdrawal charge for cash withdrawals from the policy's Cash Value.
The current charge for each cash withdrawal is US$25, HK$200, or MOP$200 [S2].
This fee applies to withdrawals made at any time to cope with emergencies [S3].
However, the withdrawal charge is waived if you use the automatic periodic withdrawal option [S2].
This waiver applies specifically to the automatic periodic withdrawal option, which has its own eligibility requirements [S4].
Additionally, a separate surrender charge may apply if you surrender the policy or decrease the Basic Sum Insured within the first 14 years of each coverage layer [S2].
This surrender charge is distinct from the per-withdrawal fee and is calculated based on factors like age, gender, and smoking status [S2].

Each cash withdrawal from the Cash Value is currently subject to a charge of US$25, HK$200, or MOP$200 [S2].
The withdrawal charge is waived for the automatic periodic withdrawal option [S2].
A separate surrender charge applies in the first 14 years from the Policy Date or the effective date of each increase in Basic Sum Insured [S2].
This surrender charge is triggered by policy lapse, surrender, or a decrease in the Basic Sum Insured [S2].
The surrender charge rate depends on the insured's gender, issue age, smoking habit, risk class, and years in effect [S2].
